profile.headline: Senior Software Developer | NYL - TCS
profile.summary:
Hello! I'm Ankit, a Software Developer based in Philadelphia, PA. I have full-time experience and expertise in developing and maintaining web applications using Angular, TypeScript, Java, Spring Boot, and Kafka. I have a track record in delivering robust and scalable applications from Pilot to Production that solve problems and drive business value.

Currently, I'm a Software Developer at TCSL, specializing in developing front-end user interfaces that meet accessibility standards and best-practices.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
• Founding Developer within New York Life’s GBS – AI Services division, delivering technical expertise and solutions since the department’s inception.
• AI-Driven Underwriting: Led the development of a high-performance frontend interface for an AI-driven contract analyzer in Angular that visualized legal provisions, accelerated prospect evaluations and reduced manual efforts for the Underwriting team.
• Feature Innovation: Architected and implemented a 'Click-to-Source' feature using using PDF.js and Angular-native event handling, automating document navigation, reducing manual search time for underwriters and accelerating the high-volume contract review lifecycle overall.
• Developed UI features for a Claim Denial generator, streamlining the lifecycle by automating initial drafts and feedback loops.
• Designed a comprehensive feedback UI to capture feedback, human-in-the-loop interactions, LLM performance metrics to refine prompts and improve overall system accuracy.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained an in-house application to track releases, components, assets, and implementations across projects, including dependency mapping and a user-friendly dashboard for comprehensive project insight.
• Migrated legacy functionality into responsive interfaces, ensuring compliance with WCAG accessibility standards.

projects.title: Release Forge: Enterprise Release Management System
projects.description:
Developed a comprehensive Release Management Dashboard designed to streamline the lifecycle of software deployments. I built the application using a Node.js/PostgreSQL backend and an Angular frontend to handle complex, multi-layered data relationships including release headers, milestones, and scope tracking.

Key Features:

Dynamic Form Architecture: Utilized Angular Reactive Forms and FormArrays to manage complex nested data entries (URLs, Milestones) with real-time validation.

Data Visualization: Integrated Chart.js to provide operational insights via status distribution donuts and release-type pie charts.

Cloud Native Deployment: Orchestrated a distributed architecture using Vercel for the UI, Render for the API, and Neon (Serverless PostgreSQL) for the database.

Advanced UX: Implemented custom Breadcrumb services, Material Design dialogs, and Route Guards to prevent data loss during unsaved edits.

projects.title: News Application
projects.description:
• Developed a web application to view news articles, and current weather information and submit feedback on articles.
• Implemented Admin user features that include adding, editing news articles, and adding new users.

Tech Stack: Angular, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap 5, Java, Spring, Swagger, MongoDB, JUnit5, Mockito, Jasmine.
